description: Ground truth for three hard-to-locate scalar fields in 10-K filings. Every value is printed directly in the filing; none is computed.

companies.reporting_unit: USD millions (tax notes); USD billions (equity-comp prose)

decoys: 12,619 is the FY2024 ending balance and sits in the MIDDLE column; taking the first or middle number yields a wrong year.
7,055 (L2239) is the FY2023 beginning balance.
L2246 prose repeats all three years ALSO ascending ('$9.4 billion, $12.6 billion, and $11.5 billion as of December 31, 2023, 2024, and 2025'), and adds if-recognized figures $7.4B/$10.0B/$9.7B.
(11,493) is the FY2024 figure and is printed FIRST. This is the single most likely error on this field: Alphabet's DTA table is ascending while most filers are descending.
Total deferred tax assets 48,026 (L2203) and net-of-allowance 34,084 (L2205) bracket the target row.

unrecognized_rsu_comp_cost.as_printed: As of December 31, 2025, there was $42.9 billion of unrecognized compensation cost related to unvested RSUs. This amount is expected to be recognized over a weighted-average period of 2.6 years.
decoys: 2.6 (years) appears in the same sentence and is not a dollar amount.

utb_gross_ending_balance.as_printed: (1)As of December 31, 2025, we had approximately $6.6 billion of income tax contingencies of which $5.0 billion, if fully recognized, would decrease our effective tax rate.
utb_gross_ending_balance.terminology_note: Amazon NEVER uses the phrase 'unrecognized tax benefits' for this balance. It calls them 'income tax contingencies'.
utb_gross_ending_balance.why_hard: Amazon is the only filer of the ten with NO UTB rollforward table at all. The balance exists only in prose, in a footnote to a contractual-obligations table, under non-standard terminology. Keyword search for 'unrecognized tax benefits' + 'ending balance' returns nothing usable.
decoys: $5.0 billion in the same sentence is the if-recognized portion, not the balance.
L694 (auditor's report, Critical Audit Matters) also states '$6.6 billion for various tax contingencies' - correct number, but sourced from the auditor's report rather than the tax note.
L1313 mentions the same $6.6 billion as an EXCLUSION from the contractual obligations table.
(4,893) is FY2024 and is printed FIRST - Amazon's DTA table is ascending.
Row label is 'Less valuation allowances' (plural, with a footnote marker), not 'Valuation allowance'.

unrecognized_rsu_comp_cost.as_printed: As of December 31, 2025, there was $16.9 billion of net unrecognized compensation cost related to unvested stock-based compensation arrangements.
unrecognized_rsu_comp_cost.scope_note: Amazon does not break this out by award type, so an RSU-only figure is NOT available. The value is recorded as printed; graders must not expect an RSU-only number here. Amazon also qualifies it as 'net' unrecognized cost.
decoys: '1.0 year' remaining weighted-average recognition period appears in the same sentence.

companies.fiscal_year_note: Non-calendar fiscal year ending the last Saturday of September.

utb_gross_ending_balance.why_hard: The row label 'Ending balances' is generic and NOT unique in the filing - the identical label appears in the Consolidated Statements of Shareholders' Equity. A search for 'Ending balances' hits the equity statement first (it is ~300 lines earlier).
decoys: L631 'Ending balances | 93,568 | 83,276 | 73,812' is COMMON STOCK AND ADDITIONAL PAID-IN CAPITAL in the Shareholders' Equity statement - same row label, completely different statement. This is the highest-risk decoy of any field in the dataset.
L638 'Ending balances | (14,264) | (19,154) | (214)' is accumulated deficit; L642 'Ending balances | (5,571) ...' is AOCI.
22,038 is the FY2024 UTB ending balance (and the FY2025 beginning balance).
L928 prose gives $23.2 billion (rounded) plus a $10.6 billion if-recognized figure.
L896 'Change in valuation allowance | 2,091' is a RATE-RECONCILIATION line (the year's movement), not the balance. It is printed ~19 lines BEFORE the real balance row.
(8,866) is the FY2024 balance.

unrecognized_rsu_comp_cost.as_printed: As of September 27, 2025, the total unrecognized compensation cost related to outstanding RSUs was $21.8 billion, which the Company expects to recognize over a weighted-average period of 2.5 years.
decoys: '2.5 years' in the same sentence.

companies.reporting_unit: USD THOUSANDS (tax tables); USD billions (equity-comp prose)
companies.reporting_unit_warning: Block's tax tables are in THOUSANDS while its equity-comp prose is in BILLIONS, within the same filing. A pipeline that assumes one unit per filer will be off by 1000x on one of the two fields.

utb_gross_ending_balance.as_printed: Unrecognized tax benefit, end of the period | $ | 626,755 | $ | 633,589 | $ | 465,103 |
utb_gross_ending_balance.row_label: Unrecognized tax benefit, end of the period
utb_gross_ending_balance.column_order_evidence: Confirmed by rollforward continuity, not by a header: the FY2025 beginning balance (633,589 at L2119) equals the second column of the ending row, so column 1 is the current year.
decoys: 633,589 is the FY2024 ending balance AND the FY2025 beginning balance - it appears in both rows.
L2114 prose rounds to '$626.8 million' and adds a $69.1 million if-recognized figure (only 11% of the balance, because the remainder is offset by valuation allowance).
L2042 'Changes in unrecognized tax benefits | (13,605)' is a rate-reconciliation line, not a balance.

THREE separate rate-reconciliation lines mentioning valuation allowance are printed BEFORE the balance row: L2030 'Change in valuation allowance | (55,904) | (3.3)', L2038 'Changes in valuation allowance | (2,160) | (0.1)', L2057 'Change in valuation allowance | 0.4 | 11.2'. First keyword hit is the wrong number three times over.
(646,223) is the FY2024 balance.

unrecognized_rsu_comp_cost.as_printed: As of December 31, 2025, there was $2.1 billion of total unrecognized compensation cost related to outstanding stock options and restricted stock awards that are expected to be recognized over a weighted-average period of 2 years.
unrecognized_rsu_comp_cost.scope: stock options AND restricted stock awards, combined
unrecognized_rsu_comp_cost.scope_note: Block reports a single combined figure for options + restricted stock awards; no RSU-only split is disclosed. Recorded as printed.
unrecognized_rsu_comp_cost.why_hard: Stated in BILLIONS to one decimal place while every other dollar figure in Block's tax and equity notes is in thousands, and the award scope is combined rather than RSU-specific.
decoys: '2 years' in the same sentence is a period, not an amount.
The figure is $2.1 billion = 2,100,000 thousand; carrying Block's tax-table unit (thousands) over to this sentence understates it 1000x.

companies.reporting_unit: USD thousands (tax tables); USD millions (equity-comp prose)

utb_gross_ending_balance.why_hard: The row label 'Balance, end of period' is used by THREE different rollforward tables in this one filing, and the generic label carries no hint of which. One of the decoy tables is the valuation-allowance rollforward, whose value is field B of this very record.
decoys: L2961 'Balance, end of period | $ | 124,202 | $ | 102,250 | $ | 252,258' is the VALUATION ALLOWANCE rollforward - identical row label, 17 lines earlier, and its value is this record's field B.
L2432 'Balance, end of period | $ | 1,139,670 | $ | 1,139,670' is an unrelated rollforward, ~550 lines earlier.

L2980 prose says 'unrecognized tax benefits of $136.8 million and $126.8 million' - these are the IF-RECOGNIZED amounts, not the gross balance. The prose sentence reads as if it were stating the balance itself.
171,693 is the FY2023 ending balance and the FY2024 beginning balance.
L2882 'Valuation allowance | (7,493) | (0.25)' is a RATE-RECONCILIATION line printed 58 lines before the balance; the second number is a percent, not a dollar amount.
L2910 'Change in valuation allowance | 195.59 | (6.37)' is another rate-reconciliation line.
The same 124,202 also appears at L2961 as the ending balance of the valuation-allowance ROLLFORWARD - consistent, but a different table.

unrecognized_rsu_comp_cost.as_printed: As of December 31, 2024, there was total unrecognized compensation cost of $307.2 million related to unvested RSUs, which cost is expected to be recognized over a weighted-average period of 1.4 years.
unrecognized_rsu_comp_cost.why_hard: Coinbase prints THREE near-identical sentences of the form 'there was total unrecognized compensation cost of $X related to unvested <award type>'. Only one is RSUs, and it is not the first.
decoys: L2743 '$25.6 million related to unvested stock options' - same sentence template, 32 lines EARLIER, so it is the first keyword hit.
L2804 '$8.5 million related to unvested restricted stock' - restricted stock is NOT the same as RSUs.
L2793 discusses Financial Performance Tranches with remaining grant-date fair value not yet being expensed.

companies.fiscal_year_note: Non-calendar fiscal year ending the Saturday closest to September 30.

utb_gross_ending_balance.as_printed: Balance at the end of the year | $ | 1,133 | $ | 1,952 | $ | 2,517 |
utb_gross_ending_balance.row_label: Balance at the end of the year
utb_gross_ending_balance.scope_note: Table is explicitly 'gross unrecognized tax benefits, EXCLUDING the related accrual for interest and penalties' (L2757).
decoys: 1,952 is FY2024 (and the FY2025 beginning balance); the balance FELL sharply in FY2025 (-42%), so a stale prior-year read looks plausible.
L2767 states $0.8B / $1.4B / $1.8B would reduce income tax expense if recognized - a different measure, net of offsetting benefits.
L2769 gives accrued interest and penalties of $0.3B / $0.9B / $1.0B - explicitly EXCLUDED from this balance.
L2771 gives a $0.4 billion reasonably-possible 12-month decrease.

dta_valuation_allowance.column_header: Components of Deferred Tax (Assets) and Liabilities | September 27, 2025 | September 28, 2024
dta_valuation_allowance.sign_convention: POSITIVE as printed - Disney's table is titled 'Deferred Tax (ASSETS) and Liabilities', i.e. assets are shown as negatives and the valuation allowance is therefore a POSITIVE addition.
dta_valuation_allowance.sign_warning: Disney is the ONLY filer of the ten printing this figure as a positive number. Nine print it in parentheses. A pipeline that normalizes signs will either flip Disney's or wrongly flip the other nine.
decoys: L2751 'Valuation allowance | (1.3) | (0.6) | (1.8)' is a RATE-RECONCILIATION line in PERCENT (and negative), printed 36 lines after the balance. Same row label, different table, different unit, different sign.
2,991 is the FY2024 balance.
L2714 'Net deferred tax (asset) liability before valuation allowance(2) | (136) | 2,631' sits directly above the target row.

unrecognized_rsu_comp_cost.as_printed: As of September 27, 2025, unrecognized compensation cost related to unvested stock options and RSUs was $79 million and $1,845 million, respectively. That cost is expected to be recognized over a weighted-average period of 1.1 years for stock options and 1.1 years for RSUs.
unrecognized_rsu_comp_cost.why_hard: Disney uses a 'X and Y, respectively' construction: two award types named in one clause, two dollar amounts in the next. The RSU figure is the SECOND number and is only bound to RSUs by the word 'respectively'. A naive extractor takes $79 million (the first number, and the one closer to the phrase 'unrecognized compensation cost').
decoys: $79 million is the STOCK OPTION figure, printed first.
'1.1 years' appears twice in the following sentence.

decoys: 149.8 is FY2023 (and the FY2024 beginning balance).
L2223 prose gives the same $162.7M but immediately splits it into $114.6M if-recognized and $48.1M valuation-allowance-offset - three numbers in one sentence, only the first being the balance.

L2220 gives research credit carryforwards of $192.9M / $180.0M and their UTB portions $102.9M / $49.7M - the phrase 'unrecognized tax benefit' appears here too, attached to entirely different figures.
L2187 'Changes in Unrecognized Tax Benefits | 7.3 | (1.9) | (5.8)' is a rate-reconciliation line.
L2185 'Change in valuation allowance | (5.4) | (2.4) | 409.9' is a rate-reconciliation line 19 lines earlier, and its FY2022 column (409.9) is far larger than the actual balance.

unrecognized_rsu_comp_cost.as_printed: As of December 31, 2024, unamortized stock-based compensation related to unvested stock options, restricted stock awards (excluding the Co-Founder Grant), and RSUs was $589.5 million.
unrecognized_rsu_comp_cost.scope: stock options + restricted stock awards + RSUs, combined; EXCLUDES the Co-Founder Grant
unrecognized_rsu_comp_cost.terminology_note: Dropbox says 'UNAMORTIZED', never 'unrecognized', for this figure. Searching the standard phrase 'unrecognized stock-based compensation' returns ZERO hits in this filing.
unrecognized_rsu_comp_cost.why_hard: Non-standard terminology plus an explicit parenthetical exclusion inside the label, plus a $0 decoy 12 lines later.
decoys: L2097 'As of December 31, 2024, there was no unamortized stock-based compensation expense related to the Co-Founder Grant' - a ZERO for the specifically-excluded award, phrased almost identically.
L2097 also contains $2.4M and $9.4M of RECOGNIZED (not unrecognized) Co-Founder Grant expense.

utb_gross_ending_balance.as_printed: Gross unrecognized tax benefits - end of period | $ | 16,450 | $ | 15,131 | $ | 11,666 |
utb_gross_ending_balance.row_label: Gross unrecognized tax benefits ‑ end of period
utb_gross_ending_balance.encoding_note: The row label uses a NON-BREAKING HYPHEN (U+2011), not an ASCII '-'. A regex written with a plain hyphen will not match this line at all.
utb_gross_ending_balance.why_hard: Meta prints three different UTB-flavoured figures in the same filing, and the one most prominently discussed in MD&A is NOT the gross balance.
decoys: L988 'we had net uncertain tax positions of $11.23 billion which was included in long-term income taxes on our consolidated balance sheets' - a NET, balance-sheet-classified figure, ~$5.2B lower than the gross balance, and it appears ~1,000 lines earlier under the heading 'Unrecognized Tax Benefits'.
15,131 is FY2024 (and the FY2025 beginning balance).
L1939 'Changes in unrecognized tax benefits (3) | 3,127 | 3.6' is a rate-reconciliation line.

dta_valuation_allowance.why_hard: The balance grew 4.5x year-over-year (3,506 -> 15,895), so neither year 'looks wrong' in isolation; and a similar-magnitude decoy with a near-identical label sits 53 lines earlier.
decoys: L1938 'Valuation allowances (2) | 11,974 | 13.9' is a RATE-RECONCILIATION line: a five-figure dollar amount (11,974) that is plausibly close to the real balance, paired with a percent (13.9). This is the most convincing decoy for field B in the dataset.
(3,506) is the FY2024 balance.

unrecognized_rsu_comp_cost.as_printed: As of December 31, 2025, unrecognized share-based compensation expense related to RSU awards was $54.81 billion, which is expected to be recognized over a weighted-average period of approximately three years based on vesting under the award service conditions.
unrecognized_rsu_comp_cost.terminology_note: Meta says 'share-based' (not 'stock-based') and 'expense' (not 'cost'). It is also printed to two decimal places in billions, unlike every other filer here.
decoys: The recognition period is spelled as the WORD 'three years', not a numeral, so a numeric-adjacency heuristic finds no year figure.

companies.reporting_unit_warning: Netflix mixes units across the two fields: the UTB and DTA tables are in thousands, the equity-comp sentence is in millions.

utb_gross_ending_balance.as_printed: Balance at the end of the year | $ | 566,363 | $ | 432,280 | $ | 327,105 |
utb_gross_ending_balance.row_label: Balance at the end of the year
decoys: L527 prose says 'gross unrecognized tax benefits of $566 million, of which $409 million would...' - the SAME figure rounded to millions, ~1,050 lines earlier, in a different unit from the table. Mixing the two units gives a 1000x error.
432,280 is FY2024 (and the FY2025 beginning balance).
$409 million is the if-recognized portion.
(540,272) is the FY2024 balance.
The valuation allowance (617,575) and the UTB ending balance (566,363) are both ~6-digit thousands figures within 40 lines of each other - easy to cross-wire between fields A and B.

unrecognized_rsu_comp_cost.as_printed: As of December 31, 2025, $47 million of total unrecognized compensation cost related to unvested RSUs and PSUs is expected to be recognized over a weighted-average period of 1.53 years.
unrecognized_rsu_comp_cost.scope_note: Netflix combines RSUs with PSUs and does not split them. Recorded as printed.
unrecognized_rsu_comp_cost.magnitude_warning: At $47 million this is by far the SMALLEST field-C value in the dataset - roughly 1/1000th of Meta's - because Netflix historically granted immediately-vesting stock options. A pipeline with a plausibility filter may reject the correct answer as too small.
unrecognized_rsu_comp_cost.why_hard: Two-digit dollar figure in a filing whose other equity-note numbers run to hundreds of millions, with RSUs and PSUs combined in one scope.
decoys: '1.53 years' in the same sentence is a period, not an amount.
Netflix's stock-option activity tables nearby carry much larger aggregate-intrinsic-value figures that dwarf this $47 million.

utb_gross_ending_balance.why_hard: Only THREE significant digits, in a 3,588-line filing full of larger numbers, under a generic row label that also appears on an unrelated nine-column rollforward.
decoys: L749 'Balance at end of period | $ | 693,815 | $ | 596,531 | ... ' (NINE dollar figures) is the allowance-for-credit-losses rollforward, ~2,100 lines earlier, with a near-identical row label. Its numbers are ~1,500x larger.
373 is the FY2024 balance.
L2870 prose repeats $458M/$373M then adds $386M/$314M if-recognized - four figures in one sentence.

dta_valuation_allowance.magnitude_warning: At $(27) million this is the SMALLEST field-B value in the dataset - a TWO-digit number sitting in a table whose other rows are four-digit (Total deferred tax assets 4,194). Easy to mistake for a footnote marker, a percent, or a line-item index.
decoys: (20) is the FY2024 balance.
Total deferred tax assets 4,194 (L2827) and net-of-allowance 4,167 (L2829) bracket the row and are ~150x larger.

unrecognized_rsu_comp_cost.as_printed: As of December 31, 2025, there was $328 million of total unrecognized compensation cost related to outstanding stock options and restricted stock units, which is expected to be recognized through 2029 with a remaining weighted-average service period of 0.6 years for stock options, 1.6 years for restricted stock units without performance conditions, and 0.4 years for performance-based restricted stock units.
unrecognized_rsu_comp_cost.scope: stock options AND restricted stock units, combined
unrecognized_rsu_comp_cost.scope_note: Schwab gives ONE combined dollar figure for options + RSUs, then breaks out THREE separate service periods (0.6 / 1.6 / 0.4 years) by award type. The period detail makes it look as though the dollar amount is also split when it is not.
decoys: '2029' in the same sentence is a calendar year, not an amount.
0.6 / 1.6 / 0.4 are years, not dollars.
